actions.content:
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DISPATCHER = ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_dispatcher.py'


def test_dispatcher_expands_untracked_directories_to_exact_files():
    text = DISPATCHER.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert '"--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"' in text
    assert 'unexpected_files:' in text
    assert 'expected_files_unchanged:' in text
